fetch_pipeline_objects: fetch diffusers pipeline objects from HuggingFace Hub and aggregate download counts by pipeline tag
fetch_pipeline_modules_to_test: fetch the list of diffusers pipeline modules to test based on HuggingFace model download usage
filter_pipelines: filter a usage dictionary to return only diffusers pipelines exceeding a given download usage cutoff
run_main: run the pipeline test matrix generation and save the test modules list to a JSON report file
review_filter_pipelines: review the filter_pipelines function to understand how it validates diffusers pipeline objects against a usage cutoff
